## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
*Example: "I am unable to push down function X when running queries over Bolt tables..."*

## Proposed Architecture / Solution
Describe the solution or design you would like to see implemented. Reference any relevant RFC from `docs/ROADMAP.md` if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, use cases, or links to related DuckDB / Apache Arrow / CUDA specifications.
